blend-sky.summary: Cover the whole canvas in soft side-to-side bands of blue and gold sunset sky.
blend-sky.tip: The light comes from a low setting sun at the right edge of the canvas, so keep the palest gold on the right side of the sky, where the after picture has it, and let the blue show more on the left side. Cover the whole canvas, about 12 in wide and 16 in tall, not just the top: the bands of Sky blue, Cream gold and Pale gold repeat all the way to the bottom edge, and the hills and cow will be painted over them later. Keep every stroke running side to side with a slight wave, like long thin clouds, rather than straight stripes.
paint_notes: The after picture has a few warmer orange streaks low in the sky; these come from Cream gold laid a little thicker over the blue, and no extra paint is needed.

lines.7: It should leave soft side-to-side bands of blue and gold over the whole canvas, with a soft join where two wet colors meet.
